nom: The Ordinary Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% High-Strength Exfoliating Serum for Uneven Texture

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report frequent relief from flaking and roughness, though some report burning, breakouts, or irritation on first use.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive or reactive skin are split: several say the serum is gentle and caused no breakouts, while others report burning, redness, or stinging severe enough to stop use.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report smoother texture, evened-out oiliness, and fewer clogged pores.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination/oily, acne-prone skin report fast texture improvement and reduced closed comedones, sometimes with initial stinging.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing mature or aging skin report smoother, firmer, more even-toned skin with reduced fine lines after regular use.
segments.normal: One reviewer describing normal, non-sensitive but sun-damaged skin reports strong lifting and smoothing effects.

concerns.aging: Multiple reviewers report reduced fine lines, plumper skin, and a firmer, more lifted look with regular use; one reviewer notes results comparable to Botox-like smoothing on the forehead.
concerns.dehydration: Several dry-skin reviewers report the serum resolves flaking and dryness without further dehydrating skin, though a few report burning or dryness especially around the eyes.
concerns.redness: Some reviewers report reduced redness and blotchiness over time, but others report the product itself triggered new redness or burning on application.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers explicitly credit the serum with not disturbing the moisture barrier, while others report burning, painful, or dry reactions suggesting barrier irritation, particularly around the eyes.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report fading of dark marks, hyperpigmentation, and acne scarring, including on darker skin tones; results are usually described as gradual over weeks to months.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report clearer skin, fewer closed comedones, whiteheads, and reduced acne, including hormonal acne; a minority report the opposite — increased breakouts, new red bumps, or cystic-feeling pimples after starting use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report the serum helps slough off dead skin without added greasiness and describe skin as glowing rather than oily afterward.

extraits.texte: I have dry, sensitive skin & this serum burns like crazy. I've tried it off & on for a couple of months, but am just going to give it away & let someone else see if it works for them.

extraits.titre: I'd compare this to Sunday Riley's lactic acid
extraits.texte: I purchased this as a dupe to SR's Good Genes Lactic Acid and i honestly didnt expect it to work as well. I was pleasantly surprised that I noticed a huge texture difference within a few days' use. I'm prone to dry skin and this did not dry or irritate my skin at all. I havent got any new breakouts since using this. Im very happy with this product.

I love this product. I was introduced to lactic acid through a much pricier serum (Good Genes) and I couldn't justify the price. I tried this on a whim and it works better for me than a product that's literally 10x the price. The formula is not elegant. it's a very watery serum that doesn't have the greatest smell. More than once I've knocked the open bottle and lost a bit of product, but at least it's incredibly affordable! I have dry, mature, slightly sensitive skin. I can't use glycolic acid without irritation, and I've found lactic acid is a great option for me because it's hydrating in addition to exfoliating. I regularly get a fair bit of superficial dryness and this product clears up the flakiness literally overnight without further drying/dehydration or irritation. I use this 2-3x per week, alternating with the days I use tret.

Ii have suffered from acne all my life, and everywhere. Face, back, chest. It has ruined my self esteem and all that, tried everything from every level and all that. Like many who buy different products from newer brands with hope that this time something will work. Well I got an allergic reaction to something right when my skin had cleared up thanks to the overwhelming difference their HA was making on my face. And I ended up with not even pimples but welts on my face and back. It has been horrifying. I had just received this product in the mail and started to use. It is crazy how this thing is attacking the welts and dark spots. Within a few days despite those days being the days I work which usually worsens my skin conditions, my skin went back down to smooth. It is now attacking the scars left (I did try picking at these). Some skin around my mouth is peeling a little because I think I let too much out a few times. Then again the places it is peeling are the areas that are darker from the rest of my skin. It really saved me from weeks, maybe months of mental anguish, because in the past when this happens I then break out with regular pimples on top of that. I saw this starting up on my chin but continued to use this with the HA and spot treated the chin ones with an overnight mask and they have almost entirely gone back down. Only one bump appears still active. Impressive for just one night. I hope this continues to help me on my journey to just regular, clear, smooth ski

extraits.titre: Did not expect it to work so fast!
extraits.texte: SKIN TYPE: Combo/oily, acne prone. I use this whenever I start to see texture on my skin and holy cow does this work FAST! I dilute this with hyaluronic acid at night time. I kid you not, I notice a HUGE difference the next morning. I love this stuff, if you're on the fence about this, trust me just try it out! WARNING: does burn a little, hence dilution.

I've used this product for over 5 years. It gently exfoliates my skin. I use it 3 or 4 times a week and I can feel the difference in my skin texture when I go more than a week without using it. I'm in my mid 50s and and my skin feels much smoother and the finish of my makeup is much more natural looking when I'm using this. It's my favorite skincare product.

extraits.titre: Burned the entire area around my eyes.
extraits.texte: This product burned the skin around my entire eye area. The area is red, dry, wrinkled, and extremely painful. I've used other acids, including tca, with no issues in the past.
